title: Generals without clearance turned away at Cape Canaveral gate
summary: Greg Rogers tells of Generals without clearance turned away at Cape Canaveral gate, about c. 1989-1990s at Cape Canaveral Air Force Station, Florida, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Cape Canaveral Air Force Station, Florida

tellings.quote: So we would have people like three star generals that are on vacation in Florida drive up

plain: Greg Rogers, introduced as a doctor who worked with NASA, the US space agency, says that sometime around 1989 to the 1990s he worked at Cape Canaveral Air Force Station, a military rocket launch site in Florida. He says high-ranking officers, even three-star generals on vacation in Florida, would drive up to the gate hoping to look around and be turned away because they lacked the right security clearance. He tells it to show how tightly some things there were guarded, if true, even from senior military people.
